note: Company is real and active in Indian customs data: registered address shown as "PLOT NO. L-9, TALOJA INDL. AREA, MIDC. DIST. RAIGARH" (Raigad, Maharashtra). It is an NLMK group service centre importing Russian/Italian steel: top suppliers NOVOLIPETSK STEEL (1418 shipments), LLC VIZ-STEEL (1471/710/509/167), NLMK VERONA S.P.A., STEELENA DMCC; ports Novorossiysk (130), JNPT/Nhava Sheva. Declared HS 850490 (static converters/parts) does NOT match the observed cargo, which is flat-rolled electrical steel: HS 72251100 (grain-oriented electrical steel, 2026-02-18 and 2026-02-07), 72251920 (non-oriented electrical steel, 2026-02-14 and 2026-02-12), 72249040 (forged plate, 2026-02-05). Per project rules this is not a rejection ground: company stays in the base, actual HS should be corrected to 7225 (flat-rolled alloy steel, grain/non-oriented electrical) with 72249040 for forged plate, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Industry claim "Энергетика" is only indirectly consistent (electrical steel for transformers/motors), not a power-equipment maker. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in accessible sources. Note also that the free ImportKey view exposes only 5 of 4595 claimed records, so the import-side picture is a sample, not a full ledger.
